column1: # SlopGene codon usage tables: codon counts from the Kazusa Codon Usage Database, https://www.kazusa.or.jp/codon/
# Nakamura Y, Gojobori T, Ikemura T. Codon usage tabulated from international DNA sequence databases: status for the year 2000. Nucleic Acids Res. 28:292 (2000).
# Kazusa tabulated the tables from NCBI-GenBank Flat File Release 160.0 (June 15 2007). Each row was read from the page named in its source column on 2026-10-23.
# Every row was checked against its page: 64 codons, counts that add up to the page's codon total, and per-thousand frequencies and
# synonymous fractions recomputed from the counts that round to the values the page shows.
# Columns: key and aliases are SlopGene's names for the table; organism, taxid (NCBI taxonomy ID), division (GenBank division), cds (number of
# coding sequences) and codons (number of codons) are as the page states them; then the count of each codon, in NCBI order (T, C, A, G).
# Escherichia coli uses the K-12 substrain W3110 (taxid 316407, 4332 CDSs), because Kazusa's table for taxid 83333 holds only 14 CDSs.
